% Mean ranks identical to those of stats.json (<= 1e-9).
% The interval (+-1.96 standard errors of the mean rank) is not fixed by the plan: it is descriptive (note FIG-1).
\begin{figure*}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig_mean_ranks.pdf}
  \caption{Top: mean rank of each configuration across the 9 datasets with all eleven configurations (1 = lowest ROC-AUC). Open circles are the per-dataset ranks; the marker is the mean rank and the bar spans $\pm 1.96$ standard errors of that mean across datasets. The interval is descriptive and is not adjusted for multiplicity; no critical-difference diagram is drawn, because with 55 pairs the Bonferroni level falls below the smallest attainable exact $p$. Ranks among the Conv1D and Conv2D variants are within run-to-run noise. Bottom: the five pre-specified H1 comparisons of each autoencoder family against the KitNET-style control (C10), as Hodges--Lehmann differences in ROC-AUC with their exact unadjusted 96.1\% confidence intervals and Holm-adjusted exact Wilcoxon $p$ values; the shaded band is the pre-specified $\pm 0.01$ ROPE. The dashed vertical lines and the hatched band are the median across datasets of $\sqrt{2}\,\mathrm{SD}_{\mathrm{pool}}$, the run-to-run noise reference of the analysis plan, at $\pm 0.073$; it is 7 times wider than the ROPE. Differences smaller than this band are not resolved with two seeds. An asterisk in the top panel marks a family whose H1 comparison is rejected at the Holm-adjusted 5\% level \emph{and} passes both pre-specified robustness rules (sign of the Hodges--Lehmann difference preserved on the within-block evaluation, and direction preserved when the KNAD captures are treated as one unit and when they are removed); a parenthesised asterisk marks a rejection that does not pass them, which the analysis plan bars from the abstract, the highlights and the contributions. To the right of each interval, the same difference is given with the six KNAD captures collapsed into a single unit ($n=4$) and with the KNAD testbed removed ($n=3$), as the analysis plan requires whenever a difference between configurations is stated.}
  \label{fig:mean-ranks}
\end{figure*}
